exposure: history of GDM in previous pregnancies
outcome: risk of developing Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus in the future
cohort: Pregnant women in Asia, typically at 24-28 weeks of gestation, from various observational studies.
finding: GDM prevalence in Asia ranged from 1.9% to 30%, with common risk factors including family history of DM, high BMI, multiparity, and previous GDM or abortion, and GDM increases future DM risk by 48%.
